data.name: 4 Hour Shelling Tour
data.headline: Starting at $140 • Boat tours up to 14 people or Private Groups up to 17 people.
data.description: Marco Island sits atop the 10,000 Islands. With so many amazing beaches just south of us, only accessible by boat, these islands are littered with amazing shells. Our guides have an incredible understandings of tides, currents, weather patterns and prevalence of different species of shells to help you find the treasures you are searching for. Whether it’s your first time combing the beach or your an avid collector,  we know where to find the best shells this area is known for. The special detail of this trip is you will go to multiple locations for your shelling adventure.
data.highlights:
This excursion is the most popular for our avid shellers in search of that rare or special shell to add to their collection. It gives ample time to search shell piles and comb along the waters edge. 

You'll get so many opportunities to find different shell species as your captain will bring you to multiple islands and beaches to treasure hunt on. This being the best option to search and find your perfect shells.

Our guests return to us year after year for this trip as they know its just the right amount of time, and our expert captains know just where to bring you. Early in the morning and away from other companies.
data.itinerary: When you arrive at the park, you will be instructed by a crew member where to park, how to get a parking pass, and where to wait for the tour. You will be waiting in the shaded pavilion area until called for your tour. If you are not approached or you do not hear your name called, please find a crew member in one of our company shirts, they say Florida Adventures and Rentals on them. Your group will be brought down to the dock and assisted to board the boat. Your captain will do a safety briefing and your tour will begin. This trip can make two to four shelling stops estimating at about 30-45 minutes to an hour at each stop if you were to choose multiple locations. Your crew will provide you with interesting facts and information about the ecosystem, history, and wildlife you come across throughout the tour. As you are walking the beach looking for shells, your captain and guide will assist in finding shells or answer any questions you may have. You are also welcome to swim, just ask your crew the best/safe place to do so. The tour will start and end at the same park location. Please note tours may start a few minutes late or end a few minutes late depending on the amount of activity at the dock as this is a public boat ramp and dock.

meeting_point.address: Goodland Boat Park | 750 Palm Point Dr Goodland, FL US 34140

data.what_is_not_included:
Gratuity for your captain and guide not included in price, so please don't forget to tip your crew!
Parking Pass at the park. Per Collier County Park rules, if you do not have a Collier County Beach Sticker on your vehicle you must purchase a $10 parking pass.
Snacks are not provided, but you're welcome to bring any food or drinks along with you.
Towels are not included
